self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: Echoing Ballad (R1): hits have a 60% chance to inflict a small AoE attack dealing 125% Physical ATK DMG (once every 4s). Modeled as a supplementary hit at the full proc value — its own rotation target (weapon/extraHit), weight = how many times it procs; physical, scales with ATK and CRIT only, no DMG% bonuses. The flat CRIT DMG +20% part is modeled separately as an unconditional self modifier.

en.flavor: A greatbow that symbolizes Dvalin's affiliation with the Anemo Archon. The sound of the bow firing is music to the Anemo Archon's ears. It contains the power of the sky and wind within.

fr.flavor: Un grand arc qui symbolise l'affiliation de Dvalin à Barbatos. Fort de la puissance du ciel et du vent, le son qu'il produit lors de la libération de la flèche est une vraie musique aux oreilles de l'Archon Anémo.
